critical_code_review_comments: Shop.jsx (lines 252-388): RCA confirmed and fix verified. Removing <AnimatePresence> around the three <TabsContent> siblings eliminated the empty-string-key collision. Each TabsContent now wraps its content in a single keyed motion.div (key='kites-content'/'companions-content'/'skies-content') which is correct because Radix Tabs unmounts the inactive ones immediately, so AnimatePresence-style exit animations were never actually firing.

Shop.jsx still uses key={item.character_id} inside each rarity section. This is safe because (a) backend /api/characters returns each character_id exactly once, and (b) each rarity section is a separate <div key={rarity}> parent, so even sibling sections cannot collide. No composite key needed.
AnimatePresence import was correctly removed from Shop.jsx imports.

rca of the issue: RCA — duplicate-keys (RESOLVED): The 8 lingering 'two children with same key' warnings traced exclusively to <AnimatePresence> wrapping three unkeyed <TabsContent> siblings in Shop.jsx. AnimatePresence requires each direct child to have a unique `key` prop; since TabsContent is a Radix primitive with no default key, all three got assigned an empty string and collided. Fix: removed the AnimatePresence wrapper (no exit animations were firing anyway because Radix Tabs unmounts inactive panels immediately) and added explicit keys to the inner motion.div for clarity. Verification: patched console.error in browser + tallied warnings across full critical path -> 0 key warnings, 0 unstable warnings, 0 other errors. Both clusters from iter 7 (4 on dashboard, 4 on shop tabs) are gone.
